schema.description: Search term. Matches the ingredient base name and every stored name in every locale, case-insensitively, as a substring — the search is deliberately not scoped to any one locale, because 54 of the 64 carry no ingredient name at all. A term of exactly seven hexadecimal characters is resolved as a FID identifier instead. Minimum 2 characters. NOTE: a two-character term is served by a scan and is measurably slower than a longer one (roughly 25 ms against 0.5 ms on the reference corpus), because the index behind this search cannot answer a pattern shorter than three characters. Two characters are permitted because a two-character term is an ordinary complete word in Chinese and Japanese. A type-ahead may prefer to wait for the third keystroke.
